name: thinktools-mcp-server
title: ThinkTools Engineering & Estimation MCP Server
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for ThinkTools.in, providing Indian civil construction estimation, material quantity thumb-rules, and toolkit catalog for autonomous AI agents.

tools.name: calculate_construction_materials
tools.description: Calculate approximate quantities of cement bags, sand (cft), aggregate (cft), and reinforcement steel (kg) for Indian residential/commercial construction based on built-up slab area.

builtUpAreaSqFt.description: Total built-up slab area in square feet (e.g. 1000, 1500, 2400)

floors.description: Number of floors (e.g. 1 for ground floor, 2 for G+1)

tools.name: get_toolkit_catalog
tools.description: Retrieve current prices, license options, and module listings for ThinkTools Construction Calculator Pro and business companion tools.
